# `Color.Ansi`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Color.Ansi — the first-class terminal colour palette.

An `AnsiColor` is the colour a terminal cell renders: the sixteen named ANSI
colours plus `default` (the terminal's own foreground or background), plus a
24-bit truecolour path. The set is closed — an invalid colour has no
representation, so a view can never name a colour the terminal cannot render.

The same `AnsiColor` type is yielded by `Ipe.Color.toAnsi` (down-sampling an
sRGB `Color` for a terminal profile); this module is the direct, first-class
way to name a palette entry. Both the Tui view surface (`Ipe.Ui.Tui.color` /
`bg`) and the Cli line surface (`Ipe.Ui.Cli.color` / `bg`) accept it.

## `black`

```ipe
black : AnsiColor
```

ANSI black (SGR foreground 30, background 40).

## `rgb`

```ipe
rgb : Int -> Int -> Int -> AnsiColor
```

`rgb r g b` — a 24-bit truecolour from red/green/blue channels (0-255).
Rendered on terminals that support truecolour; the named palette above is the
portable path.

## `rgba`

```ipe
rgba : Int -> Int -> Int -> Float -> AnsiColor
```

`rgba r g b a` — a 24-bit truecolour with an alpha channel (0..1).
